mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, description, tech_stack, created_at, updated_at, url FROM works WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO works (user_id, title, description, tech_stack, url, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{techStack}, #{url}, now(), now())
mapper.update: UPDATE works SET title=#{title}, description=#{description}, tech_stack=#{techStack}, url=#{url}, updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId}
